column3: “Not yet is come” is rendered “is not yet here,” and “ready” is “opportune.”
NASB has “I do not go up,” following the reading “not” (the critical text has “not”; the Textus Receptus has “not yet”); “fulfilled” is rendered “fully come.”
NASB follows the critical text; it adds “to them.”
NASB has a stray quotation mark at the end of the verse.
NASB renders “Good He is” as “He is a good man” and “deceives” as “leads … astray.”
NASB follows the critical text; “knows writings” is rendered “become learned,” and “studied” is “been educated.”
NASB renders “keeps” as “carries out” and adds “and yet.”
NASB follows the critical text; “work” is rendered “deed.”
NASB puts the clause about the fathers in parentheses; “Because of this” is attached to Moses, which is uncertain.
NASB renders “made an entire man sound” as “made an entire man well.”
NASB follows the critical text; the question expecting “no” is rendered “do they?” NASB omits “truly” before “know.”
“Take” is rendered “seize,” and “no one” is “no man.”
